incidents.what: The first notice-dismiss loop pressed "Resume this sale" on an old unpaid ZZ TEST Parent sale of 1 Oct (฿1935) at Reception Till 1. Resume only reads the sale; the tab was closed without paying, cancelling or voiding it.

HARNESS FAULT: the notice loop pressed the first button of each old "left unpaid" notice at Reception Till 1, which is "Void that unpaid sale" on most of them, in two passes (20:15:26-28 UTC and 20:18:24-25 UTC; the second pass ran the old helper from the module cache). 16 old unpaid sales (tendering, no money taken) from 23 Sep to 14 Oct were voided with the left-behind reason, voided by Som. Two others were opened with Resume and left unpaid. The tab was closed without paying or voiding anything else.

abandonedPath.what: A first step 5 attempt (1 Hour Play, one kid and no adult) opened the children-playing-alone screen; it was backed out before anything was rung up (no sale request sent) and its two pictures were deleted.

readBack.voidReason: ZZ TEST proof clean-up: unpaid duplicate left by the SCRUM-773 staging proof run

renames.why: Opened with the Read tool, neither image shows a sale-level document line: both sales were priced from the member profile, which carries the document instead (tierClaim null on both). The names now say what the pictures show. The sale-level line is shown by 09j, on a walk-in claim with no details given.

proofAgent3.harnessChange: Before any browser work the notice helper dismissLeftBehind was replaced by one that throws, and every step that called it was moved out of the harness. In this run no button on any till notice was pressed; the notices were only read (n1) and one was photographed (09k). Nothing older than today was voided.
proofAgent3.reviewed: The 33 captured images were each opened with the Read tool. 31 show what their names claim on the live commit. 09c and 09f were named for a sale-level document line they do not show (both sales were priced from the member profile) and were renamed; step 9 was re-run as s9n on a walk-in claim with no details given.

finding.what: A walk-in who claims a tier on the till and then types a phone and nickname on the customer display leaves an unpaid copy of the sale behind. The payment screen records the sale as a walk-in with the claim as soon as Done is pressed (01a1a846-fd17, 20:36:27Z); the member is saved a second later (member.tier_verify 20:36:28Z); the Confirm press then records a second sale under the new member (01a1a847-4764, T1-000087, 20:36:46Z) and the first stays tendering, so the till later shows it as "Your sale rung up at this till was left unpaid" (09k).
finding.scope: Not part of SCRUM-765 or SCRUM-773: the deferred tier save (SCRUM-227) meeting the sale recorded when the payment screen opens (S2-09a).
finding.cleanup: The copy left by this proof was voided through the API on the till session with a ZZ TEST clean-up reason (cleanup.leftoverSale).
